value.signature: fn dependency_commitment (id : & ActId , p : & ProposalCommitment , salt : & SecretSlice < u8 > , list : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < DependencyCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { if ! valid_id (id) { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } salt_format (salt) ? ; let (list , _) = dependencies (list , None) ? ; let digest = hash (DEPENDENCY_RECIPE , "PN-dependency-v1" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , proposal_anchor (p) ?, SecretValue :: Bytes (salt . clone ()) , list ,] ,) ? ; Ok (DependencyCommitment { recipe : DEPENDENCY_RECIPE . into () , bytes : publish (& digest) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The typed operation retains its public carrier or secret-container boundary; opening publication is explicit and never authenticates the retained anchor.
